title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise
description: Years after the events of Predacons Rising, Bumblebee is summoned back to Earth to battle several of Cybertron’s most wanted Decepticons that escaped from a crashed prison ship and assembles a team of young Autobots that includes Sideswipe (a rebel “bad boy bot”), Strongarm (an Elite Guard cadet), Grimlock (a bombastic Dinobot), and Fixit (a hyperactive Mini-Con with faulty wiring).Season 1 is Not Available in Tamil-Telugu

episodes.title: S1-E17One of Our Mini-Cons Is Missing

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x1
episodes_data.description: Assigned on a solo mission to Earth, Bumblebee unexpectedly finds himself saddled with a team.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x2
episodes_data.description: Bumblebee and his new team must stop a Decepticon from reaching nearby Crown City.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x3
episodes_data.description: The Autobot team must learn to work together as they face two Decepticon fugitives.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x4
episodes_data.description: As Russell nervously tries befriending the neighborhood kids, Fixit - craving the action of a field assignment - gets in way over his head.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x5
episodes_data.description: Beleaguered Bumblebee must learn to lead in his own way as the team struggles to bring in a brutish Decepticon whose stasis pod has been discovered by human authorities.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x6
episodes_data.description: Sideswipe's loyalty to the team comes into question as he and Bumblebee track down a Cybertronian crime-boss.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x7
episodes_data.description: As Denny and Russell work to stave off a greedy memorabilia collector, Bee and his team chase a collector of their own - a Decepticon with an impulsive urge to hoard all things "shiny."

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x8
episodes_data.description: When Grimlock suddenly starts attacking his teammates, Bee must figure out why the stalwart Dinobot has turned from friend to foe.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x9
episodes_data.description: While Strongarm's first "solo" mission is marred by an over-protective Bumblebee, Denny's and Fixit's rivalry comes to a head.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x10
episodes_data.description: The Bee Team welcomes a visiting Autobot veteran just in time to fend off a Decepticon fugitive bent on monopolizing one of the Bots' most precious commodities.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x11
episodes_data.description: While in pursuit of a rebellious Decepticon, Bumblebee is exposed to a toxin that impacts his maturity, leaving the rest of the Bee Team to deal with both an escaped fugitive and a hyperactive leader.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x12
episodes_data.description: When two rival Bounty Hunters land on Earth, Bumblebee discovers that there's a price on his head.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x13
episodes_data.description: While Bee and his Team try to bring in a gang of Decepticon thieves, Optimus readies himself for a coming evil that will threaten both Earth and Cybertron.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x14
episodes_data.description: Bee and his team encounter a new Decepticon who inadvertently leads them to discover Steeljaw's gang.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x15
episodes_data.description: A mind-controlling Decepticon captures the Autobots and traps them within nightmares. It's up to Russell to rescue them.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x16
episodes_data.description: Sideswipe is captured and has his body stolen by an insane Decepticon.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x17
episodes_data.description: Drift returns to Earth in pursuit of a disgruntled, runaway Jetstorm. Meanwhile, Springload and Quillfire make an escape.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x18
episodes_data.description: Grimlock tries to hide an injury while the Autobots track down an aquatic Decepticon.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x19
episodes_data.description: Grimlock goes up against an unstoppable Decepticon gladiator.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x20
episodes_data.description: Fixit needs a repair job from Denny, but it goes wrong and he turns into a sentry bent on wiping out fugitives.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x21
episodes_data.description: Steeljaw and his group manage to get into the scrapyard to release cryogenically Decepticon prisoners that the Autobots have captured up to now. Our heroes will have to show cunning to thwart their plan and regain control of the scrapyard.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x22
episodes_data.description: Grimlock discovers another Dinobot fugitive with whom he sympathizes. He helps them flee, but it does not take long to destroy everything and terrorize the humans. Our heroes will have to join forces to stop it. Denny redecorates a motor home and Russell is afraid of what his father made.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x23
episodes_data.description: Sideswipe meets a female Autobot named Windblade on a mission for Optimus Prime. She agrees to team up with Bumblebee's Team to bring in a Decepticon that has a striking resemblance to a Queen Bee.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x24
episodes_data.description: When Bumblebee decides to show his team the beauty of Earth, he takes them to a ghost town in the Far West where a Decepticon able to change form awaits them. As they wonder through the town, the 'Bots get into various hijinks and traps triggered by themselves. Afterwards, Bumblebee finds his team fighting something that isn't really there and stops them. The Decepticon opens various holes in the floor, trapping the 'Bots.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x25
episodes_data.description:
In the wake of a coming threat to Earth by Steeljaw's gang, the Primes decide to send Optimus there despite his training not yet complete.

As Optimus prepares to return to Earth to face the mysterious "Evil" he's prophesied, the Bee Team must prevent Steeljaw's Pack from teleporting that same threat onto Earth.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 1x26
episodes_data.description: Reunited with Optimus Prime, Bee and his Team must use everything they’ve learned to stop the annihilation of both Earth and Cybertron.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x1
episodes_data.description: The Bee Team must cope with a global Decepticon threat and a weakened Optimus Prime.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x2
episodes_data.description: While the away team struggles against the elements to capture Polarclaw, Bumblebee's team tracks Overload.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x3
episodes_data.description: While trying to apprehend Saberhorn, Strongarm and Grimlock struggle to recreate the teamwork Strongarm had with Sideswipe.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x4
episodes_data.description: After a mistake in the field, Strongarm takes herself out of action just when the team needs her most against fire-starting Decepticons Crazybolt and Slicedice.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x5
episodes_data.description: Windblade is concerned about Optimus' well being, but doing so puts the Away Team at risk as they battle Razorpaw.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x6
episodes_data.description: Grimlock tries to make himself smarter by absorbing information from a Cybertronian data cylinder into his brain, but something goes wrong and leaves the team at a disadvantage.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x7
episodes_data.description: Steeljaw creates a plan to infiltrate the scrapyard by sending Bumblebee, Grimlock, and Strongarm into a trap.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x8
episodes_data.description: Bumblebee takes a night off to see his favorite band, but things get dangerous when Bisk attacks the stadium.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x9
episodes_data.description: With Bumblebee and Strongarm stuck at an impound lot, Grimlock must find a disguise when Quillfire returns.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x10
episodes_data.description: Fixit's repairs to the GroundBridge go wrong, summoning two of the most dangerous Decepticons on the planet and banishing Bumblebee to another dimension.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x11
episodes_data.description: Slipstream and Jetstorm expose Drift to danger when attempting to prove that they can work effectively without him.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x12
episodes_data.description: After the two teams are reunited, the Autobots get support from an old friend, and begin the raid on Decepticon Island.

episodes_data.title: Transformers: Robots In Disguise 2x13
episodes_data.description: The severely outnumbered Autobots on Decepticon Island desperately search for a way to stop Steeljaw and his army. Tensions between Bumblebee and Optimus could put the mission, and the entire world, at risk.
